test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Dollar Bahu’ is written by whom among the following Indian authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sudha Murty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dollar Bahu**

 
 
• Dollar Bahu is written by Sudha Murty.
 
• Her Kannada-language novel Dollar Bahu, which was later translated into English as Dollar Bahu, was turned into a dramatic television series by Zee TV in 2001.
 
• The narrative describes a middle-class family's effort to become an upper-class one through their kid in the United States.
 
• The Marathi film Pitruroon, based on the Sudha Murthy short tale Runa, was directed by Nitish Bhardwaj.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kiran Desai** 

 
 
• Kiran Desai, an Indian English author, wrote Inheritance of Loss in **2006**, which also received the **Man Booker Prize** that year
 
 
 
• **Arundhati Roy **
 
 
• **​Capitalism**, **The God of Small Things**, and** An Ordinary Person’s Guide to Empire** are written by Arundhati Roy.
 
 
 
• **Khushwant Singh**
 
 
• The last authored book by Khushwant Singh is **Khushwantnama**, **The Lessons Of My Life**.
